basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Project Research Scientist I (Centre of Excellence in Affordable Healthcare) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Centre of Excellence in Affordable Healthcare at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur has one Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) - Research post in the ICMR-sponsored project "Responsible AI-Powered Thermal Imaging System for Point-of-Care Diagnosis of Cervical Lymphadenopathy". The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 61,600 per month, depending on qualification and experience, for 36 months or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. A Post Graduate Degree in the relevant subject (or a 4-year Graduate Degree for Engineering/IT/CS) is the essential qualification. Ap

age_limit.details: The qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and mere possession of the same does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

qualification.details: Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG degree, in relevant subject; OR for Engineering/IT/CS, 4-year Graduate Degree.

how_to_apply: The notice invites applications online under Advertisement No. IIT/SRIC/R/TRL/2026/101; the last date of application is 10 December 2026. The application fee is Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.
The notice also prints fee deposit details, to be paid through RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking etc., and says the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form:
Bank name: State Bank of India (00202)
Bank address: P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal-721302
Name of bank account: IIT SRIC-OM Account

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG degree, in relevant subject; OR for Engineering/IT/CS, 4-year Graduate Degree. First Class M.Tech degree in ECE/EE/IN/BME/CSE. GATE/NET qualified. Candidate interested in pursuing a PhD through the project. Candidates having hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas will be preferred: embedded system design and development; computer vision and image processing; edge computing and deployment. The qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and mere possession of the same does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) - Research post carries consolidated compensation of up to Rs. 61,600 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The tenure is 36 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The notice calls the assignment temporary.
